checks.text: The page shows the heading "Hash Generator" and the text "Enter text to hash" in the input area.

Typing "hello" in the CodeArea labelled "Input text", selecting "SHA-256" in the select labelled "Algorithm", and selecting "hex" in the select labelled "Encoding" shows the text "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824" in the field labelled "Result".
With "hello" in the Input text, selecting "SHA-1" in the Algorithm select and "base64" in the Encoding select shows the text "gCqF1eIz9H3D9V2W8X4Y6Z0A1B2=" in the Result field.

With "hello" in the Input text, selecting "SHA-256" in the Algorithm select and "url" in the Encoding select shows the text "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824" in the Result field, with no percent-encoding applied to the hex characters.

Clicking the button "Copy result" with "hello" hashed as SHA-256 hex changes the button label to "Copied" for 2 seconds, and the clipboard contains "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824".

After generating a hash of "hello" as SHA-256 hex, clicking the button "Add to history" adds a row to the table labelled "History" containing "hello", "SHA-256", "hex", and "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824".
Clicking the button "Clear history" removes all rows from the History table and shows the text "No history yet".

With "hello" in the Input text, selecting "SHA-512" in the Algorithm select and "hex" in the Encoding select shows the text "9b71d224bd62f3785d96d46ad3ea3d73319bfbc2890caadae2dff72519673ca72323c3d99ba5c11d7c7acc6e14b8c5da0c4663475c2e5c3adef6627b3466cfc7" in the Result field.

Reload keeps the history entry: after adding "hello" SHA-256 hex to history and reloading the page, the History table still contains a row with "hello", "SHA-256", "hex", and "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824".
